description.message: Connect the active kiosk application to FoxOE and its Stream Deck.

connectTab.message: Use this tab as the FoxOE kiosk

setupHelp.message: Use this extension in the dedicated kiosk browser profile. Copy the connection token from FoxOE Settings, then open the dashboard and click the FoxOE toolbar icon to select the kiosk tab.

connectionSaved.message: Connection saved. Open the dashboard and click the FoxOE toolbar icon.
